2608.16868.title: Towards Computational Provenance: Carrying Causal-State Evidence in Generated Text
2608.16868.paper_summary: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We study computational provenance: whether generated text can carry detectable evidence of which causally relevant internal state occurred. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate states, allowing different internal paths to produce the same answer. We deliberately switch between these paths, authenticate the state actually used, and let that verified state determine a subtle statistical pattern in the generated text that can later be detected. The feed-forward and transformer systems each passed all 128 matched pairs in both their public and separately sealed protected end-to-end evaluations, with the detector recovering the signal associated with the authenticated internal state. The required causal computation also reproduced across five independently trained feed-forward models and three independently trained transformers. In a separate answer-only transformer experiment, our linear probes did not recover a naturally learned intermediate state. These results provide a controlled proof of concept that information about a verified, causally relevant internal state can be preserved in generated text even when the answer is unchanged.
2608.16868.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型的輸出本身並不提供關於產生該輸出的內部計算的可驗證證據。我們研究計算來源：生成的文本是否能攜帶可檢測的證據，顯示出發生了哪種因果相關的內部狀態。我們在兩個受控架構中測試這一想法的有限形式：一個模組化的前饋神經網絡和一個基於Transformer的模型。這兩種架構都在相同的算術任務上進行訓練，並強制通過兩個離散的中間狀態，允許不同的內部路徑產生相同的答案。我們故意在這些路徑之間切換，驗證實際使用的狀態，並讓該驗證的狀態決定生成文本中的微妙統計模式，這在後續可以被檢測到。前饋和Transformer系統在其公共和單獨密封的保護端到端評估中，都通過了所有128對匹配的樣本，檢測器恢復了與驗證的內部狀態相關的信號。所需的因果計算也在五個獨立訓練的前饋模型和三個獨立訓練的Transformer中重現。在一個單獨的僅回答的Transformer實驗中，我們的線性探針未能恢復自然學習的中間狀態。這些結果提供了一個受控的概念證明，證明了有關經過驗證的、因果相關的內部狀態的信息可以在生成的文本中保留，即使答案不變。
2608.16868.author: Benjamin Belay et.al.
